verdict.rationale: Ramp documents rules-based approval workflows that route requests to the right stakeholders by vendor type, spend category, dollar amount, or team role, and its spend controls describe approval workflows applied across cards, reimbursements, bills and agent purchases. Nothing shows explicitly ordered multi-step chains such as manager, then budget owner, then finance. Nothing covers approver delegation or time-based escalation when approvers sit on requests; the AI 'escalates when it's not [safe]' line refers to agent risk-flagging, not approver escalation. Missing for 10: explicit sequential multi-level chain configuration, approver delegation/out-of-office, escalation or reminders for stalled approvals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
